facts.statement: The fixed entry compresses with ZSTD_compressStream2, decompresses with ZSTD_decompressStream, then performs an in-place ZSTD_decompressDCtx round trip.
The build recipe enters tests/fuzz and invokes ./fuzz.py build all. It does not itself establish a successful build or the active compile-time branches.

In the supplied before source, ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary accepts dictionary bytes only in the context init stage, copies nonempty content into the context, and clears any previously configured dictionary. ZSTD_CCtx_refCDict is another init-stage setup route.

In the supplied before source, streaming initialization initializes a local dictionary if present, derives parameters using the configured CDict size, and passes the prefix or CDict to ZSTD_compressBegin_internal.

evidence.dependency_reason: ZSTD_compressStream2 invokes transparent streaming initialization when the context is in its init stage.

facts.statement: In the supplied before source, compression initialization inserts configured dictionary content. Auto dictionary content accepts non-magic raw content of at least eight bytes and loads it into the match state.

evidence.dependency_reason: ZSTD_compress_insertDictionary handles the supplied bytes and calls ZSTD_loadDictionaryContent for raw content.

facts.statement: The before-source block selector has distinct ordinary, external-dictionary, dictionary-match-state, and dedicated-dictionary-search compressors; ZSTD_buildSeqStore selects by match-state dictionary mode.

evidence.dependency_reason: The caller derives dictMode from the current match state.
The internal parser and sequence-producer fallback pass that dictMode to the selector.

facts.statement: A registered external sequence producer is an alternate compression path. On producer failure with fallback enabled, the before source selects an internal block compressor using dictionary mode; otherwise the producer path supplies NULL and zero dictionary bytes to its callback.

The fixed entry resets only the compression session before compression and after completed frames. In the before source, session-only reset leaves configured dictionaries intact; parameter reset clears them.

evidence.dependency_reason: The reset implementation distinguishes session-only reset from parameter reset and dictionary clearing.

facts.statement: The complete fixed entry and its complete parameter-setting helper contain no explicit compression or decompression dictionary load or reference call. The entry does invoke FUZZ_SEQ_PROD_SETUP, whose expansion is not supplied here, so this does not rule out every setup route.

evidence.dependency_reason: The complete called helper sets compression parameters and sequence-producer state but contains no dictionary setup call.

facts.statement: The existing checks require error-free stream compression and decompression, complete stream-frame decompression, and both decoded results to equal the original bytes and size.

evidence.dependency_reason: The assertion macros abort on a false condition or a zstd error.

missing_information: The expansion and active build branch of FUZZ_SEQ_PROD_SETUP are not supplied in this continuation, so an equivalent dictionary setup route through that macro remains unresolved.
